distractors.reason: We don't say 'time border'. 'Border' refers to the edge of a country or an area, not to a period of time.
We don't say 'time edge'. 'Edge' describes the outer side of an object, not a maximum amount of time.
We don't say 'time wall'. 'Wall' is a physical structure and cannot describe a limit on time.

example_sentence: The oral exam has a strict time ___ of ten minutes.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar, 'sınır' gibi kelimeleri 'limit of time' şeklinde kurmaya meyilli olabilir; oysa İngilizcede isim+isim yapısında 'time limit' kullanılır, birinci isim ikinci ismi niteler.
explanation: In English, 'time limit' is a compound noun in which the first noun, 'time', describes the second noun, 'limit'. This is a fixed partnership, so the order cannot be reversed or replaced with 'of'.

related_collocations.example: The project has a clear time frame of six months.
The deadline for the report is next Friday.
Good time management helped me finish my project early.

memory_tip: TIME LIMIT = the maximum amount of time allowed | TIME FRAME = the period during which something happens
